title: TopologySemanticSelectorPredicate
description: One catalog-backed predicate in a typed topology selector. The schema enforces the stable envelope; topology-service validates catalog-specific operator and value compatibility.

catalogId.description: Semantic catalog field id used by this predicate, for example inventory.device.vendor or network.stp.port_role.

op.description: Predicate operator. The operator must also be allowed by the referenced catalog entry.

value.description: Single typed predicate value for operators such as eq, neq, contains, match, gt, gte, lt, or lte.

values.description: Multiple typed predicate values for operators such as in or between.
